QUOTE: "Cancel-flag poller | `src/inference/inference_c_api.cpp:385` | Bridges `int*` cancel to `std::atomic<bool>` at 10 ms"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer lists cancel bridges between `int*` and `atomic<bool>`, but it never says the thread exists because the C ABI boundary cannot carry an atomic. The "Generator observer" row also mirrors an atomic flag into an int without giving that reason.
